sources.notes: The Arkansas Museum of Fine Arts website and events pages describe classes and workshops in various media (wire art, glass torchworking, printmaking, metalsmithing, woodcarving, painting, audition skills). None of the pages mention firing in a kiln or pit, wood, soda, salt, raku, pit/barrel/saggar, or gas reduction firings. Although the museum is known to offer raku firings, these specific pages contain no evidence of raku classes, workshops, or firings, no dates, no descriptions of how potters can participate, and no quotes naming a firing type or kiln. The membership benefits mention discounts on classes but do not specify any firing-based classes. Therefore, no opportunities can be recorded based on the text provided."
